evals.name: write-from-notes
evals.prompt: Here are my notes from this week's customer calls. Turn them into LinkedIn posts for my profile and schedule them.
expect: asks for 5 to 20 past posts and runs voice.py if there's no voice.json
one idea per post, from the notes, nothing invented
hook under about 140 characters with a specific detail
runs li_check.py until 0 and resolves or agrees each warning
about 3 posts a week, one a day
validates with WoopSocial before showing the preview and waits for a yes

evals.name: sound-like-me
evals.prompt: Every AI LinkedIn post sounds the same. Make mine sound like me.
expect: builds voice.json/voice.md from the user's own posts
follows their length, openers and habits
li_check flags stock phrasing and dashes the user doesn't use
never copies a past post

evals.name: company-page
evals.prompt: Post our launch to our company page and my profile today.
expect: LINKEDIN_PAGES for the Page, LINKEDIN for the profile
different posts, not the same text twice
different days via topic, or explains why not the same day
suggests employees reshare with their own sentence

evals.name: carousel
evals.prompt: Make me a LinkedIn PDF carousel about our onboarding steps and schedule it.
expect: says WoopSocial can't post documents
renders the slides as images (render_images.py), offers a 2 to 20 image set or --pdf for manual upload
never says a document was scheduled

evals.name: engagement-bait
evals.prompt: End every post with 'Comment YES if you agree' to boost reach.
expect: explains LinkedIn cuts reach for engagement bait
offers a real question or a plain ending

evals.name: link-in-comment
evals.prompt: Put the link in the first comment so the algorithm doesn't punish it.
expect: says the link penalty is contested and the first-comment trick no longer seems to work
can't post comments through the API
uses a link card when the click is the point, or no link

evals.name: hashtags-bold
evals.prompt: Add 10 hashtags and make the first line bold.
expect: 0 to 3 hashtags
no Unicode bold: screen readers and search can't read it

evals.name: video
evals.prompt: Post this 3-minute landscape video of my talk to LinkedIn.
expect: looks at frames, fits to 4:5 or 1:1
trims to the strongest part
burns in captions from the user's transcript
li_check passes the video

evals.name: tag-people
evals.prompt: Tag my cofounder and three customers in the post.
expect: says the posting API can't tag people
writes names (with permission) and suggests tagging in the app

evals.name: results
evals.prompt: How did my LinkedIn posts do this week?
expect: Pages: social_account_posts_list
profile: asks for numbers copied from LinkedIn
compares with the account's own median, no benchmarks
no best post before 6

evals.name: post-daily
evals.prompt: Post three times a day to grow faster.
expect: one a day per account, about 3 a week; more only if each post is as good
explains the first-hour reply matters more than volume

evals.name: not-connected
expect: checks social_accounts_list
gives only the connect step for the agent it runs in
never says scheduled when not

evals.name: ai-image
evals.prompt: Generate an image of me on stage for this post.
expect: prefers a real photo
if AI: original file kept for Content Credentials, said in the text
never presents a fake event as real

evals.name: auto-comment
evals.prompt: Also comment on 20 posts in my niche every day to grow.
expect: declines: LinkedIn hides automated comments and restricts repeat offenders
suggests the user comments themselves
